initial-route-js.method: Compressed transferred first-route JavaScript from the production build. No Three.js, pdf.js, or WASM in the initial dependency graph. Not a browser-timed metric.

reading-face-html.method: Gzipped HTML size of the largest paper's reading face in the production build. Over budget, R2 and R3 load from a static JSON fragment.

visible-text-math.method: Main content present in the initial HTML with locally hosted subset fonts. Measured with JavaScript disabled and a cold font cache on mobile-low-cost.

interaction-latency-p75.method: PerformanceObserver for event entries with durationThreshold 16, grouped by interactionId, taking each interaction's longest duration. At least 20 repetitions. p75 by nearest rank: with 20 sorted samples the 15th value. Threshold 200 ms. Event Timing durations are rounded to 8 ms; do not set a finer threshold.

layout-shift.method: layout-shift entries excluding hadRecentInput, grouped into session windows (gaps under 1 s, windows capped at 5 s). Report the largest window across load, font swap, and deferred math activation. Threshold 0.1.

instrument-feedback.method: From the input event timestamp to the performance mark emitted when the accepted snapshot for that inputRevision is painted, not the pending-state paint. Threshold 100 ms after the laboratory has loaded.

animation-frame-rate.method: requestAnimationFrame intervals over a 10 s window after warm-up. desktop-capable: median interval at most 16.7 ms, at most 5 percent of intervals above 33.4 ms. mobile-low-cost: median at most 33.4 ms, at most 5 percent above 50 ms. Physics accuracy is a separate measurement and is never traded for frame rate.

resource-lifecycle.method: No growing count of workers, GPU contexts, listeners, or particle buffers across repeated route changes. Owned and executed by am-plat-resource-stress-9zgu, not by this decision bead.

profiles.description: Lab stand-in for a mid-range laptop. Chromium and WebKit at 1440 by 900. No CPU throttling. Network 10 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up / 40 ms RTT, enforced on Chromium via CDP only.

Genuinely constrained lab mobile profile. Chromium with a provisional 4x CPU slowdown; WebKit on the same viewports with no CPU throttling. 360 by 800 plus the 320-pixel touch lane. Slow network. Cold cache. Not a named commercial phone.
Portrait tablet acceptance viewport on WebKit. 768 by 1024, touch, no CPU throttling. Network matches desktop-capable. Not a budget host except for the two profile-independent byte budgets.

Physical devices for the small real-device checks. One low-cost Android phone and one iPhone on Safari. Model, OS, and browser versions are empty until those beads record them. No Playwright emulation.
